cases.title: no approval, deny, TTL expiry or closed input: nothing runs
executable, argv, cwd, uid, env or nonce changed after approval is rejected
another allowlisted requester cannot redeem; the original still can
32+ concurrent claims of one approval run at most once
token/nonce replay, including after restart, is denied
missing client cert, foreign CA/fingerprint, wrong SAN, expired cert, bad TLS version: denied before execution
malformed, wrong-type, empty, truncated or oversized frames: controlled denial, no panic or hang
read/write errors and short header/body writes are not reported as a delivered frame
claim-store create/write/fsync failure fails closed
executable changed between approve and claim: denied (not a proof against stat->exec TOCTOU)
stdout/stderr, large output, nonzero/signal exit returned; stdin closed, no extra FDs
env allowlist and fixed PATH; no implicit shell or PATH lookup
N/pair: real Linux SO_PEERCRED; sandbox without root/sudo, docker.sock or host access
OpenShell O1/O2 port control and rule removal/restore; O4 restart without recreate
SIGKILL of the broker closes the agent path; human password sudo keeps working
client disconnects and concurrent connections do not bypass one-shot or identity checks
cwd outside allowed_cwd_roots (realpath, symlinks resolved) is denied before approval; empty roots deny all; relative root is a config error
env policy: fixed_env keys not overridable, PATH never requestable or allowlisted, values single-line and at most 4096 bytes, denied before approval
the approved cwd directory is held by fd until exec and the child chdirs through it; a swap after the last check does not move the command; the fd closes on every outcome
claim files expire at TTL + 24h and are collected at start and hourly; unreadable files stay; replay inside the TTL is still denied after restart
approval comes only from approver_uids over the host approver socket: requesters and TLS peers cannot list or decide; the first decision wins; a decision binds to the shown request hash
